_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Frost Bite#000.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#001.dst: もう一度やってみよう！
Frost Bite#001.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#003.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#003.dst: くそ。ドリルがどうしても動かない。
Frost Bite#003.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#004.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up here to the drill, maybe you can take a look?
Frost Bite#004.dst: おい、そこの衛兵！電磁魔法に詳しいか？ドリルのところまで上がって、見てくれないか？
Frost Bite#004.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#005.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#005.dst: おっ！やっぱりいい、点いた、下がれ！
Frost Bite#005.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#006.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#006.dst: Bob に誓って…なぜ砕けないんだ？
Frost Bite#006.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#007.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#007.dst: この氷を作ったのは Theorick、はるか昔にこの地を守っていた Twain 家の一人だ。
Frost Bite#007.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#008.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#008.dst: 腐敗が手に負えなくなったとき…彼は人々も含めて何もかも凍らせた。中に見えるだろう？
Frost Bite#008.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#009.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#009.dst: 必死に彼らを出そうとしてきた。この Corkus 製ドリルも含め、手持ちの機材は全部試した。
Frost Bite#009.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#010.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#010.dst: もっと派手な手を使うべきかもな…爆破の専門家 Rhudya が洞窟の奥にいる。
Frost Bite#010.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#011.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#011.dst: 望みは薄いが、試す価値はある。私がここを片付けている間に取ってきてくれないか？
Frost Bite#011.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#012.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#012.dst: 洞窟の奥へ進み、Rhudya と話す。

Frost Bite#013.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#013.dst: おっと！ここは私有地だよ！ん、Eppo の使いかい？なら構わないさ。
Frost Bite#013.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#014.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#014.dst: それならこの TNT がいるね。落とさないでおくれよ、おっと！
Frost Bite#014.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#015.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#015.dst: この洞窟を抜ければ、あっという間に Eppo のところへ戻れるよ！
Frost Bite#015.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#016.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.
Frost Bite#016.dst: TNT を持って Eppo のもとへ戻る。

Frost Bite#017.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#017.dst: よし、これならいけるかもしれない。
Frost Bite#017.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#018.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#018.dst: 下がって、爆薬に火をつける。
Frost Bite#018.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#020.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#020.dst: 何も起きない？傷一つない。Theorick の氷は分からん…まともじゃない。
Frost Bite#020.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#021.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#021.dst: これ以上何ができるのか…
Frost Bite#021.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#022.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#022.dst: おーい、Eppo、こっちだよ！洞窟のそば！
Frost Bite#022.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#023.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#023.dst: 爆薬、効かなかったのかい？洞窟からの帰りに古い坑道を見つけてね、昔の溶岩洞に通じてるんだ。
Frost Bite#023.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#024.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#024.dst: 望みは薄いかもしれないけど、あそこの溶岩は何か違うんだ。試してみたら？
Frost Bite#024.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#025.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.
Frost Bite#025.dst: 坑道を抜けて溶岩泉へ向かう。

Frost Bite#026.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.
Frost Bite#026.dst: パズルを解き、溶岩を Eppo のもとへ持ち帰る。

Frost Bite#027.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#027.dst: 溶岩をバケツに入れて運べるとは…まあ、現にこうしてある。
Frost Bite#027.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#028.dst: 実はな…理由もなくこの遺体を掘り出しているわけじゃない。
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#029.dst: この中の一人が Theorick に仕えていて、屋敷の鍵を持っているはずなんだ
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#030.dst: {p} の我々は、Theorick には償うべきことが山ほどあると考えている。彼の財産を被害者たちに分け直したいんだ。
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#031.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
Frost Bite#031.dst: よし、この棒を魔法の溶岩に浸しておいた。棒を持って氷に入っていけば溶ける。
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#032.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#032.dst: 鍵を持った遺体を探してくれ、上の方かもしれない。頼んだぞ！
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#033.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.
Frost Bite#033.dst: 氷を溶かし、召使いの遺体を見つける。

Frost Bite#034.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#034.dst: それで合ってるか？取れた？見事だ！さあ降りてきてくれ。
Frost Bite#034.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#035.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#035.dst: 一緒に屋敷へ行こう。ほら、私の馬に乗ってくれ。
Frost Bite#035.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#036.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#036.dst: 道すがら、私たちのしていることをもう少し話そう。行くぞ。
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#037.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#037.dst: 前にも言ったが、この地が凍っているのには訳がある。自然のものじゃない。
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#038.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#038.dst: Bob が現れるずっと前、Wynn は腐敗戦争で荒れ果てていた。
Frost Bite#038.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#039.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#039.dst: 当時、Twain 家と呼ばれる生まれつきの才に恵まれた者たちがいた。彼らは元素魔法で皆を守っていたんだ。
Frost Bite#039.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#040.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#040.dst: Theorick もその一人だ。異常なほど強力な氷の魔法を操り、それで屋敷の周りの土地を守っていた。
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#041.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#041.dst: Theorick は…他の Twain 家の者とは違った。守った民に、礼として金と食料を納めさせたんだ。
Frost Bite#041.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#042.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#042.dst: 何年も経つと、Theorick は富み、守られた民は貧困と恐怖に暮らした――怪物だけでなく、Theorick 自身を恐れてな。
Frost Bite#042.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#043.dst: 門限に背いた者を罰し、誰かが出て行こうとすれば激怒した。人々は囚われた気分だった。
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#044.dst: やがて他の Twain 家の者と同じく――Theorick も腐敗に堕ちた。だがその前に、最後の仕打ちをした。
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#045.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#045.dst: 彼はこの地を丸ごと凍らせ、外にいたほぼすべての命を奪った。何百もの命が失われたんだ。
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#046.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#046.dst: ところが、その氷のおかげで腐敗の広がりはほとんど止まった。それ以来ずっとこのままだ。
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#047.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#047.dst: 屋敷に入れるようになった今、彼の氷魔法の秘密を解き明かして元に戻し、民から奪い溜めた富を分け合いたい。ああ、着いたぞ。
Frost Bite#047.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#049.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#049.dst: 時が凍りついたような場所だ…この豪華さ…まあ、周りの皆から奪うだけ奪った男だからな。
Frost Bite#049.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#050.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#050.dst: どこから手をつければいいか分からないが、何か守りの仕掛けがあるはずだ。
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: This is unbelievable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#051.dst: 信じられん…なんて強欲な――うわあああ。
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#052.dst: …悪口は言わない方がよさそうだ…
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.
Frost Bite#053.dst: Theorick の屋敷で財宝を探す。

Frost Bite#054.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#054.dst: うっ！予想外だった。私の言った通りだな。悪口を言う者を罰するんだ。
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#055.dst: とにかく、隠し通路のようなものを探してみよう。
Frost Bite#055.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#056.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#056.dst: 自分の家に罠を仕掛けるなんて、さすが Theorick、疑り深い氷漬けのじじ――
Frost Bite#056.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#057.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#057.dst: 全然楽しくないな。何も見えない。ここはどこだ、行き止まりか？
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#058.dst: 悪口を言えば罰を受けると分かった。なら、褒めれば喜ぶんじゃないか？
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#059.dst: ああ Theorick、Twain 家最強のお方、あなたこそ真の英雄です。
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#061.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#061.dst: ついに私室を見つけたようだ、あの金庫の扉を見てくれ。
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: There must be a way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#062.dst: 開ける方法があるはずだ。辺りを調べて何か探してくれ。
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Find your way into the vault.
Frost Bite#063.dst: 金庫へ入る方法を見つける。

Frost Bite#064.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#064.dst: やったな！金庫に入れるぞ。
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: Wow, even by today's standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#065.dst: すごい、今の基準でも莫大な金額だ。何百年も前ならどれほどの価値だったか。
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#066.dst: 君も少し持っていってくれ、君がいなければここまで来られなかった。
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#067.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#067.dst: 待て、これを見てくれ。Theorick の鎧の一部らしい。
Frost Bite#067.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#068.dst: あの肥えた頭によく収まったもんだ。
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo
